designSummary: Two-group prospective comparison of change scores in 14 residents, analysed by linear regression with adjustment for baseline score and training year.
sampleSize: The sample is fixed at the 14 residents in the programme. If about 8 take part in coaching and 6 do not, and the standard deviation of change is about 2 points (retrieved comparison), the 95 percent confidence interval for the difference in change will be roughly 2.3 points either side of the estimate, too wide to exclude no effect if the true difference is 1.8 points. The study is therefore reported as a local estimate with its interval, and as a source of variance estimates for a multi-programme study.
primaryAnalysis: Linear regression of change in blinded score on coaching participation, baseline score and training year; difference with 95 percent confidence interval; no significance test is the basis for a decision.
secondaryAnalysis: Description of autonomy ratings over the year by group; number of sessions attended; concern scores at start and end.
missingData: A resident with a missing end-of-year video is reported and excluded from the primary analysis; no imputation with 14 residents.
multiplicity: One primary outcome; secondary outcomes descriptive.
overfittingGuards: Analysis fixed before videos are rated
summary: Local estimate with its interval from 14 residents; the study informs a larger study rather than settling the question.
